breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition. The incomplete prompt contained a confusing preamble with multiple, contradictory definitions for `dx`. The agent correctly identified the specific instruction for this periodic domain problem (`dx=1/Nx`) and omitted the incorrect, contradictory information, thereby removing the ambiguity. This aligns with the ground truth, which also removed the contradictory text.
